system.description:
You may take an action and push yourself to do one of the following (you also gain the benefits of pushing yourself):

    • The finger of an angry god - you may make a single shot with a ranged weapon at extreme distance. If you can see the target, you can hit it.

    • A hail of falling stars - you fire a suppressive barrage of projectiles with your ranged weapon, reloading with superhuman speed. Enemies caught in the barrage must succeed on a fortune roll in order to act without getting hit.
